title: Pizza Recipe
description: One curated recipe, in baker's-percentage form. Mirrors capstone.recipe.Recipe for the modeled fields, plus raw_text/mapping for provenance so every converted value can be traced back to the source.

field_mapping.description: How one field's value was derived from raw_text.

raw.description: The exact snippet from raw_text this value came from, e.g. '922g Tipo 00 flour (100%)' or '2 teaspoons instant yeast'.

method.description: How raw was turned into the field's value - a Conversions method/table name (e.g. 'to_grams', 'to_baker_percentage', 'match_alias', 'split_starter', 'YEAST_TO_INSTANT_RATIO'), or 'manual' for a judgment call not covered by Conversions.

note.description: Optional - explain any exceptional or non-obvious decision (assumed default, ambiguous match, range midpoint taken, etc.).

source.description: URL or citation for the original recipe.

raw_text.description: Verbatim recipe text as it appears in the source .md file, unedited.

mapping.description: One field_mapping entry per converted field below, keyed by field name.
